questions: Should the bar chart be displayed (plt.show()) before returning, or should the function avoid showing the plot interactively?
What should happen if the input dictionary is empty?
Should the bars be ordered by color name, by frequency (descending/ascending), or by first appearance?
If a color appears multiple times, should the bar be labeled with the color name exactly as provided (preserving case) or normalized (e.g., lowercased)?
Is the width of the bars required to be exactly 0.4, or is any reasonable width acceptable as long as the bars are maroon?
Should the function create a new figure (plt.figure()) each call, or can it reuse the current figure?
Are the x‑axis labels expected to be exactly the color strings, or should they be formatted (e.g., capitalized, trimmed)?
Should the DataFrame preserve the original order of items from the dictionary, or is any order acceptable?
